color_light_modal_width_tooltip: Without modal width, the optimum width is used for the UI component, depending on the specified height.
dialog_set_oid_tooltip: With opening the dialog, the state is set.
echarts_axes_empty: No axes yet — every axis follows its series; the first series creates the first axis.
echarts_axes_hint: Each axis is individually configurable; further axes render side-by-side.
echarts_axis_align_conflict: A value range or tick setting (min/max, tick segments, min interval) disables alignment for this axis — echarts then ignores it.
echarts_axis_align_hint: Tick alignment is cross-axis: an axis with 'Align ticks' re-ticks against the first displayed axis (the reference). The reference axis itself has no switch.
echarts_axis_died_info: Axis removed — its series left the data: %s
echarts_axis_rebind_unit_mismatch: Series rebound to an axis with a different unit. Please check the scale.
echarts_datasource_preset_hint: Applies as the preset for every series; each series can override it on its card.
echarts_decimal_comma_hint: Applies to every chart value: tooltip rows, legend values and the default Y-axis labels. An explicitly authored axis format stays unchanged.
echarts_editor_advanced_note: Only keys the GUI does not manage take effect here.
echarts_editor_discard_text: Your changes are not saved yet. Discard them and close the chart editor?
echarts_editor_info_json: Single OID supplies the data — auto-detects array vs { series: [] }.
echarts_editor_mode_hint_history: Fetches aggregated data from the History adapter (24 h / 7 d / 30 d) — filled immediately, refreshed periodically and on value change. Requires a History adapter.
echarts_editor_mode_hint_json: A single state delivers ready-made series data (Array or { series: [] }). You style or hide series by name; the payload sets count and values.
echarts_family_boundary_loss: Switching the chart family deletes %s series and %s axes
echarts_family_loss_snippets: %s active template(s) will be removed on Apply
echarts_json_kind_boundary_loss: Switching the payload family deletes %s series and %s axes
echarts_mode_boundary_loss: Switching to or from JSON deletes %s series and %s axes
echarts_editor_json_kind_hint_series: The payload carries finished series — you style or hide them by name.
echarts_editor_json_kind_hint_table: The payload is a rows list — pick the rows path and the X/Y columns; the data point stays the same.
echarts_mapping_hint: Choose the rows list of the payload, the X column (a date column yields the time axis, anything else a category axis) and — in the Series section — the Y columns as series.
echarts_mapping_no_array: The payload contains no rows list yet — pick a state whose value is a JSON array (or an object containing one).
echarts_table_series_hint: One card per bound Y column — the rows list and the X column live in the Data source section.
echarts_table_duplicate_names: Two series carry the same display name — legend and tooltip cannot tell them apart.
echarts_val_ypath_missing: Y column %s is missing from the payload — the series renders empty.
echarts_val_ypath_string: Y column %s is text-typed — it plots empty points only.
echarts_preview_configure_table: Map the columns — pick the X and Y columns in the configurator
echarts_instance_auto_hint: Auto uses the history instance configured on the datapoint itself (e.g. sql.0, influxdb.0). Only if none is configured there does the server decide (default history instance).
echarts_instance_missing: No history adapter found — install history/sql/influxdb and enable it for the OID.
echarts_json_no_oid: Select a JSON data point under Data source
echarts_json_parse_error: JSON data point could not be read
echarts_json_series_empty: The JSON data point defines no series
echarts_json_duplicate_names: Duplicate names in the payload: series with the same name share style, axis binding and hiding — give them unique names.
echarts_json_series_hint: The payload defines these series — here you only style or hide them (no add/remove).
echarts_legend_orient_hint: Orientation follows the edge (top/bottom horizontal, left/right vertical)
echarts_marks_hint: Reference lines with style and label, anchored to a Y-axis
echarts_preview_json_no_series: The data point yields no plottable data — check its format; table documents need the 'Table/columns' family.
echarts_preview_open_series: Click to open the matching section
echarts_renderer_info: Canvas (default) = faster for live & large data. SVG = crisp for print, export, zoom.
echarts_series_cumulative_help: Running total over the non-null values; gaps stay gaps, no reset. Runs after the smoothing window when both are on.
echarts_series_data_preset_hint: The Data source section holds the default for every series — each value here inherits it and can override it per series.
echarts_series_formula_help: Conversion formula for the value. Symbol: val — e.g. val / 1000 + 3. An invalid formula keeps the raw values. Context symbols: smin, smax, savg, sfirst, slast = this series' minimum, maximum, average, first and last value (gaps skipped).
echarts_series_formula_invalid: Invalid formula — raw values are used
echarts_series_smooth_window_help: Centered moving window over the configured points, clipped at the edges; gaps stay gaps — they are never interpolated. Odd windows keep the window symmetric.
echarts_series_value_map_help: The mapping matches exactly on String(raw value). An empty target is a deliberate gap (never filled); unmatched values pass through the normal numeric intake unchanged.
echarts_series_xoffset_bar_limit: The X offset shifts only the request window: in the category bar chart a shifted series lands outside the shared bar grid (empty buckets).
echarts_splitter_hint: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
echarts_time_static_incomplete: Both dates are needed — until then the default window applies.
echarts_time_static_invalid: Start must lie before end — until fixed, the window resolves to the default.
echarts_val_stale_yaxis: References an axis that no longer exists — it renders on axis 1.
echarts_visualmap_hint: Continuous colour gradient by value (overrides series colours)
echarts_x_fmt_auto_hint: Adaptive: seconds and the date prefix follow the data span; the date appears at day changes and chart start.
echarts_x_format_tokens:
e.g. HH:mm · DD.MM. · ddd · HH
DD.MM.
enable_icon_color_mask_tooltip: Applies color mask to URL-based icons. Not available for Base64/embedded icons.
ignore_common_states_tooltip: Recommended when common.states has more than 20 entries. A large number of states can cause the vis-2 editor to freeze.
json_table_auto_tooltip: Smart default based on column type '{type}': {smart}
json_table_condition_mode_hint_or: at least one condition must match
json_table_depth_warning: JSON depth ({{actual}}) exceeds configured max ({{configured}}). Some nested data is not expanded.
json_table_filter_advanced_active: Advanced filter active. Clear to edit inline.
json_table_filter_dialog_description: Select an operator and enter a value to filter the column.
json_table_filter_no_value_needed: This filter does not require a value
json_table_filtering_tooltip: Column filtering requires column menu to be enabled
json_table_header_elevation_tooltip: Shadow intensity of the table header (0=none, 24=strong)
json_table_hiding_tooltip: Allow columns to be hidden via column menu
json_table_image_tint_hint: Tints the image via a colour mask.
json_table_invalid_type: OID type must be 'string' or 'mixed' containing JSON
json_table_max_depth_tooltip: Maximum depth for flattening nested JSON objects (1-50)
json_table_no_columns: No columns discovered. Select an OID and click refresh.
json_table_no_format_options: No formatting options for this column type
json_table_no_style_rules_hint: Add a rule to color cells based on their value.
json_table_override_tooltip: This column overrides the global {feature} setting
json_table_reset_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to reset all columns to their default values? All formatting and styles will be removed.
json_table_rule_priority_tooltip: Priority for conflicts – P1 takes precedence
json_table_rules_all_match_hint: All matching rules are applied – for conflicts: Rule 1 takes priority over Rule 2 etc.
json_table_rules_priority_hint: Rules are evaluated in order – the first matching rule wins
json_table_show_header_tooltip: Hides the column header row. Per-column sorting, filtering, column menu and resize are removed while hidden; the global quick filter stays.
json_table_unsaved_changes: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
json_table_virtualize_threshold_tooltip: Minimum number of rows to enable virtualization (0 to disable)
label: Label
show_ok_button_tooltip: If enabled, the value is sent only after clicking OK, pressing Enter, or leaving the field. Otherwise each keystroke is sent (debounced).
state_push_button_tooltip: Pressing the button sets value[1] and releasing it sets value[2].
theme_studio_discard_text: Your changes are not saved yet. Discard them and close the theme editor?
theme_studio_feintuning_hint: Bundled fonts ship real 400 and 700 faces only — other weights are synthesised by the browser and can look muddy.
theme_studio_help_css_vars: Generates a CSS variable for every theme value (e.g. --mui-palette-primary-main) you can use in your own CSS, plus real light/dark via color-scheme. Only needed if you want to reference theme colors as CSS variables.
theme_studio_help_direction: Text direction: LTR (left-to-right, default) or RTL (right-to-left, e.g. for Arabic or Hebrew).
theme_studio_help_fonts: Font sources — Bundled: shipped with the collection, always available and consistent (even offline). System: installed on the viewing device; no bundle cost but rendering varies by device. Google: loaded once and embedded. Custom: any CSS font name (e.g. a locally installed font outside the list).
theme_studio_help_spacing: MUI's spacing factor (default 8). Controls all padding, gaps and margins of MUI components — higher means more generous spacing.
theme_studio_save_error: Saving failed — check the connection and try again.
theme_studio_save_invalid: Fix the marked problems to save
theme_studio_valid_color: must be a color (gradients are not allowed)
theme_studio_valid_range: value is out of the allowed range
theme_studio_valid_unknown: unknown option — may be ignored by MUI
theme_wizard_typography_font_family_samp: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
theme_wizard_typography_weight_hint: Light = headings h1–h2, Regular = body text, Medium = buttons & subtitles, Bold = strong/emphasis.
